d: Five members press 'Odoslať' at the same moment in five browsers
pre: round open; each member on the last step with different answers
steps: click Odoslať in all five within the same tick
exp: five thank-you screens; 5 responses and 5 participations; the multiset of stored answers equals what was sent (MVP-09)
actual: responses/participations=5/5; stored=1234,2345,3451,4512,5123

d: NFR-01 after simultaneous submissions: stored order gives no hint who sent what
steps: SELECT rowid FROM Response; read rows in table order; compare with participation order
exp: no rowid (WITHOUT ROWID); rows come out ordered by the random UUID
actual: Response.rowid not available; Participation.rowid not available; table order = UUID order: true

d: The manager's list shows the participation of the moment after a reload
steps: manager Alfa opens /rounds; HR opens /hr/rounds
exp: '5 z 6' in both rows
actual: manager row=true, HR row=true

d: The same member submits from two tabs at the same moment
pre: Adam has the round on the last step in two tabs of one browser
steps: click Odoslať in both tabs together
exp: exactly 1 response and 1 participation; one tab thanks, the other says the round is already filled in
actual: responses/participations=1/1; tabs: Toto kolo už máš vyplnené | Ďakujeme za odpoveď

d: Six parallel API submissions of one member
steps: 6× POST responses in parallel
exp: exactly one 201, five 409; 1 new response
actual: statuses=409,409,409,409,409,201; responses/participations=2/2

d: Members submit in the browser while the manager closes the round in another browser
pre: Cyril, Dana and Emil on the last step; manager on /rounds with the close dialog open
steps: all three click Odoslať and the manager confirms 'Uzavrieť' at the same moment
exp: every member sees either the thank-you or 'Kolo je uzavreté'; responses = participations = number of thank-you screens + 2; no 500 (MVP-09, BUG-002)
actual: screens=Ďakujeme za odpoveď | Ďakujeme za odpoveď | Ďakujeme za odpoveď; responses/participations=5/5; submission after close → HTTP 409

d: Race repeated on the API: 10 rounds, 5 submissions against a simultaneous close
steps: for each: 5 POST responses and 1 POST close in parallel
exp: in every round responses = participations = number of 201 answers; no 500
actual: inconsistent rounds=none; rounds where all 5 got in before the close=2/10

d: HR and the manager start the same draft at the same moment
pre: draft visible to both; both have the confirm dialog open
steps: both confirm 'Spustiť' together
exp: round OPEN once; one gets the toast, the other the toast or 'Kolo medzitým zmenilo stav. Obnov stránku.'; no generic error
actual: db=OPEN; HR={"toast":1,"stale":0,"generic":0}; manager={"toast":0,"stale":1,"generic":0}

d: HR and the manager close the same round at the same moment
steps: both confirm 'Uzavrieť' together
exp: CLOSED once with one closedAt; each sees success or the stale-state message; no generic error
actual: db=CLOSED; HR={"toast":1,"stale":0,"generic":0}; manager={"toast":0,"stale":1,"generic":0}

d: Two managers save a round for their own teams at the same moment
pre: manager Alfa and manager Beta on /rounds/new
steps: both click 'Uložiť koncept' together
exp: two drafts, one per team, each with its own team's defaults; each manager sees only the own one
actual: Alfa draft team ok=true, Beta draft team ok=true; cross-visibility=false

d: A step written by the manager is visible to HR and to a team member after their next page load
pre: round 1 closed above the threshold; HR has its results open, Adam has the team page open
steps: manager adds a step in the browser; HR reloads results and the overview; Adam reloads the team page
exp: HR sees the step (read-only) and the overview counts it; Adam sees it under the round (MVP-13, MVP-14)
actual: HR before reload=false (no live update is expected), HR after reload=true, employee after reload=true

d: Step status changed in one tab is shown correctly in a second tab of the same manager after that tab refreshes its data
pre: manager has the results page open in tabs T1 and T2; step is 'Plánované'
steps: T2: set the step to 'Hotové'. T1 (not reloaded): add a second step (the page refreshes its data from the server)
exp: after the refresh T1 shows the first step as 'Hotové' – the same as the database
actual: T1 shows 'DONE' for the first step; database has 'DONE'

d: Issue status changed by one HR session is shown correctly in a second HR session after that session refreshes its data
pre: two HR browser sessions on /hr/issues with the same two open issues
steps: session 2: set issue X to 'Rieši sa'. Session 1 (not reloaded): change the owner group of issue Y (the list refreshes from the server)
exp: after the refresh session 1 shows issue X as 'Rieši sa' – the same as the database
actual: session 1 shows 'IN_PROGRESS' for issue X; database has 'IN_PROGRESS'

d: With rounds open in both teams, each member sees only the own team's round
steps: Adam (Alfa) and Filip (Beta) open the home page
exp: Adam: only 'Pulse – iba Alfa QA'; Filip: only 'Pulse – iba Beta QA'
actual: Adam sees Alfa=true, Beta=false; Filip sees Beta=true, Alfa=false

d: A member cannot answer the other team's round even with its address
steps: Filip: open the fill page of the Alfa round; POST responses
exp: 403 page; API 403; nothing stored
actual: 403 page=true; API HTTP 403; responses/participations=0/0

d: A manager cannot start, close or write a step on the other team's round
pre: Beta round open; Alfa round 1 closed
steps: manager Alfa: POST close on the Beta round; manager Beta: POST action on Alfa round 1 and open/close on Alfa rounds
exp: 403 each; states unchanged (matrix, NFR-03)
actual: 403,403,403; Beta round OPEN, Alfa round OPEN

d: Each manager's list and home tasks contain only the own team
pre: rounds and tasks exist in both teams
steps: manager Beta opens '/' and /rounds
exp: no Alfa round name on either page
actual: Alfa round names visible to manager Beta: none

d: HR sees the rounds of both teams in one list with the right team on each row
steps: HR opens /hr/rounds; compare every row with the database
exp: row count = number of rounds; each row links to its team
actual: rows=18, DB rounds=18, wrong team label=0

d: Five identical own questions sent at once are stored once
steps: 5× POST /api/questions with the same text in parallel
exp: one 201, the rest 400/409 duplicate; 1 row (BUG-005)

d: Five people send a kudos to the same colleague at once
steps: 5× POST /api/kudos in parallel; recipient opens /kudos
exp: 5 rows; the recipient's tab shows 5

d: Round closes once when several people load pages at its deadline
pre: open Beta round with closesAt shifted 1 minute into the past (time simulation)
steps: manager Beta, HR and two members request their pages/API in parallel
exp: CLOSED with closedAt = closesAt; no 500 from any request
actual: statuses=200,200,200,200,200,200; db=CLOSED; closedAt==closesAt: true

d: Database integrity after all concurrent scenarios
steps: count rows per round; look for duplicates
exp: responses = participations everywhere; no duplicate participation; no response in a draft
actual: rounds=18; inconsistent=none

d: No uncaught JavaScript error in any of the parallel sessions
steps: collect 'pageerror' events
exp: none
